method: Each unmodified original PNG opened individually with view_image; byte size and SHA256 independently matched to the original report. No rerun or image editing.

findings.affectedScenes: playing in native, occupied-port and Rosetta
findings.description: Separate instructions card overlaps the upper part of the lower-right minimap by approximately 50–60 image pixels (visual estimate, not DOM measurement). Compact ID card does not cover lap/time. Expanded pause card covers the background minimap but not the pause buttons.

observations.notes: Title/logo, kart and start prompt are clearly rendered. Expanded controller card shows full wrapped ID, game name and actual TCP port; it does not obstruct the start prompt.

Kart, track/grass/tyre barrier and spectator scene are rendered. Lap 1/3, timer and 8th place are readable; this still shows 0 km/h and is not itself evidence of sustained driving. Compact ID card is readable. The separate instructions card overlaps the upper part of the bottom-right minimap by approximately 50–60 image pixels (visual estimate only).
Resume, Restart Race and Quit to Menu are readable and unobstructed; Resume is visibly selected. The expanded controller card covers the minimap behind it but not the central pause controls.
